reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: Provision of a long-term senior secured loan of up to EUR 30 million (the "Loan") in favour of MEL3 Gayrimenkul Gelistirme Yatirim Insaat ve Ticaret A.S. (the "Company" or "Mel 3 Gayrimenkul"), a fully owned subsidiary of Rönesans Gayrimenkul Yatirim A.S. ("RGY"). The Loan will support the preservation of human capital and the livelihoods of people in the South-Eastern part of Türkiye, which was impacted by the earthquake on 6th of February 2023. The Loan proceeds will be used for (i) replacing emergency bridge financing provided by RGY for the repair CAPEX of two shopping centres and (ii) support to be provided to tenants of the shopping centres in the earthquake affected region.
